plan.title: Publish complete Technical + RFQ eRFX project

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is possible.
Set a unique project title, which is required before publishing.
Configure the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
Add the required line item to the project.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
Set and save the event duration schedule.
Add two QA test vendors to the project audience.
Publish the completed eRFX project and handle the confirmation flow.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify the published project details area is present.
Verify the Technical stage is shown on the published project.
Verify the RFQ stage is shown on the published project.
Verify the published project exposes the Master QCS view.
Verify the published-stage section is rendered.
